svg.title: One GP1 step as an FSM and a BT
svg.desc: Tag 1, left: a state machine for moving one tested cell. read_voltage leads to pick_from_tester, which leads to place_in_slot when the cell is in range and to recycle_cell when it is out of range; both lead to done. Dashed red arrows run from read_voltage, pick_from_tester, place_in_slot and recycle_cell to a state named stopped: one failure transition per working state. Tag 2, right: the same step as a behavior tree, indented the way py_trees prints it. The sequence move_cell holds read_voltage, pick_from_tester and the selector place_or_recycle; the selector holds the sequence place_if_good (voltage_in_range, then place_in_slot) and recycle_cell.
